title: A  proteomic analysis of livers from RagAGTP mice
projectDescription: A proteomic analysis of livers from RagAGTP/ TSC-KO mice
sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein extraction from liver with 5% SDS. S-TRAP aided trypsin digestion, isobaric peptide labeling (TMT-pro16). HpH prefractionation of peptides. LC-MS/MS analysis (Q-Exactive).
dataProcessingProtocol: RAW data processed with MaxQuant. Statistical analysis with Prostar using Limma.
